successors.name: Colony of British Columbia
successors.text: Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands (the researcher's polygon round the island)

ledger.x: 1849: the island is leased to the Hudson's Bay Company.
1859: the HBC lease ends ('during 1849-1859'); the page gives no month.
1866: the colony ends while the San Juan standoff goes on; the contest passes to the united Colony of British Columbia (which records the 1871 arbitration).
1866: Vancouver Island is merged into British Columbia.
1866: the Colony of Vancouver Island ends in November 1866.

wars.name: Pig War
wars.outcome: A bloodless boundary standoff over the San Juan Islands; they were 'awarded to the United States following third-party arbitration by the German Empire in 1871' (Pig War page); troops stayed on San Juan Island until 1874.
